_note: Optional pins: US dollars per million tokens, keyed by the canonical model spec a run records (<provider>/<model>), as { input, output, cacheRead?, cacheWrite? }. There are none by default. A rate entered by hand goes stale and can be a guess (a cache rate for Sonnet 5.5 was), so a cost comes from the provider if it reports one, else a market quote from OpenRouter for a model with an alias (src/harness/price-aliases.json), else it is null, which is a normal state. Add a pin only to cost a run at fixed rates; it takes precedence over a quote. A model with a pin but no cache rates is priced at the input rate for cached tokens.
